text:
maya (pm): Quick check-in: customers want a clear isolation roadmap + launch gates. Need decision by next Wed.

linh (eng-plat): Proposal: three phased capabilities: 1) policy-driven soft-affinity + observable fallback, 2) reserved lanes with eviction semantics, 3) private control plane. Each phase has an acceptance checklist.

adrian (infra): For reserved lanes we must pick pool model: tenant-dedicated vs tagged reservations on shared nodes. Dedicated = simpler SLA, higher cost. Tagged = cheaper, complex eviction.

kevin (sre): Ops must own chaos tests for eviction and cross-region spill. Add automatic throttle for non-critical tenants when egress spike detected.

sofia (sales): Two pilots (FinCorp, Healthly) want reserved or private options. Sales needs a one-pager mapping price delta to reduced tail latency.

linh (eng-plat): API sketch: "redwood policy set --tenant T --tier reserved --regions eu-west-1,us-east-1 --fallback nearest". Console needs cost + latency estimator.

maya (pm): Launch gates (for reserved): billing hooks + quota enforcement, canary with paying customers, documented rollback. Add model-compatibility matrix from research.

research-bot: Note: quantized kernels incompatible with some warm-start optimizations; will publish matrix by Fri.

adrian (infra): Risk: cold-starts on dedicated pools -> propose a warm buffer SKU baked into pricing.

kevin (sre): I'll own runbooks and SLO alerts. Will start drafting chaos scenarios.

maya (pm): I'll draft the decision doc and assign owners. Ping me with missing risks.
